# Design Handoff: Session Materials And Q&A
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

## Result

The approved local increment adds two tabs to the session detail sidebar. `Session Materials` remains the default tab and keeps the existing authenticated downloads. `Q&A` adds a session-scoped feed where active authenticated users can ask, answer, and upvote.

## Confirmed Rules

| Area | Direction |
|---|---|
| Question form | Title plus optional details |
| Participation | All active authenticated users may ask, answer, and upvote |
| Ownership | Authors may edit or delete their own content |
| Administration | Administrators may edit or delete any question or answer |
| Feed | Simple session feed; search, filters, and advanced sorting are deferred |
| Question feed height | Fixed-height feed sized for about three normal question cards; only the feed scrolls after the visible limit |
| Question form | Collapsed by default; `Ask a question` toggles the form open or closed |
| Materials | Existing protected material list and download route remain in place |
| Layout | Sidebar on wide screens; stacked below the recording on smaller screens |

## Acceptance Boundary

- The session view shows both tabs and preserves the existing recording.
- Materials list entries remain downloadable only through authenticated server routes.
- Questions and answers cannot cross session boundaries.
- Guests, pending users, and revoked users cannot access the session or Q&A endpoints.
- Users cannot edit or delete another user's content.
- Administrators can moderate all questions and answers.
- A user can toggle one vote per question and answer.
- The question form stays outside the scroll container, and the question feed scrolls after about three normal question cards.
- The question form is collapsed by default and opens only when the user selects `Ask a question`.
- The implementation remains local and does not authorize staging or production.
